about: Questions this archive can answer, each with the SQL that answers it. Every one is executed on each build; the build fails if one stops answering.

questions.question: What did the district budget in total, in each year and at each stage?
questions.sql: SELECT fy, stage, ROUND(SUM(value)) AS total FROM budget_figure GROUP BY fy, stage ORDER BY fy, stage
questions.note: A STAGE is not a period. `proposed`, `settled` and `actual` are three different documents about the same year, and mixing them is the error rule 1 exists for.

questions.question: Which budget lines grew fastest across the years the archive holds?
questions.sql: WITH span AS (SELECT line_key, MIN(fy) AS first_fy, MAX(fy) AS last_fy FROM budget_figure WHERE stage='settled' GROUP BY line_key HAVING last_fy > first_fy) SELECT b.label, s.first_fy, s.last_fy, ROUND(a.value) AS started, ROUND(z.value) AS ended, ROUND(100.0*(z.value-a.value)/a.value,1) AS pct FROM span s JOIN budget_line b USING (line_key) JOIN budget_figure a ON a.line_key=s.line_key AND a.fy=s.first_fy AND a.stage='settled' JOIN budget_figure z ON z.line_key=s.line_key AND z.fy=s.last_fy AND z.stage='settled' WHERE a.value > 1000 ORDER BY pct DESC LIMIT 20
questions.note: Both ends are the SAME stage. A rate measured from an actual to a budget is partly growth and partly the step between them, which is rule 1.

questions.question: Which lines do two documents state differently, and by how much?
questions.sql: SELECT label, fy, stage, ROUND(spread) AS spread FROM v_budget_disagreement WHERE spread > 0 ORDER BY spread DESC LIMIT 20
questions.note: The documents disagree with themselves by up to 1.5%, which is larger than most variances anybody wants to measure.

questions.question: What does each FY27 scenario total?
questions.sql: SELECT variant, ROUND(SUM(value)) AS total, COUNT(*) AS lines FROM budget_figure WHERE fy=2027 AND variant IS NOT NULL GROUP BY variant ORDER BY total DESC

questions.question: How many budget lines are there in each section of the budget?
questions.sql: SELECT section, COUNT(*) AS lines FROM budget_line GROUP BY section ORDER BY lines DESC

questions.question: Which function groups hold the most budget lines?
questions.sql: SELECT function_group, COUNT(*) AS lines FROM budget_line WHERE function_group <> '' GROUP BY function_group ORDER BY lines DESC LIMIT 15

questions.question: What is in the FY27 workbook, by column?
questions.sql: SELECT column_kind, COUNT(*) AS rows, ROUND(SUM(value)) AS total FROM workbook_figure WHERE row_kind='line' GROUP BY column_kind ORDER BY rows DESC
questions.note: Filter `row_kind='line'`: the sheet's own TOTAL rows are loaded too, and summing without the filter double-counts roughly fourfold.

questions.question: Which budget lines appear in the workbook but not in the line catalogue?
questions.sql: SELECT DISTINCT w.line_key FROM workbook_figure w LEFT JOIN budget_line b USING (line_key) WHERE b.line_key IS NULL LIMIT 20

questions.question: How many figures rest on a document that two sources report differently?
questions.sql: SELECT fy, COUNT(*) AS figures FROM budget_figure WHERE documents_disagree=1 GROUP BY fy ORDER BY fy

questions.question: What is the total salary line in each year, and does the stage change it?
questions.sql: SELECT fy, stage, total FROM total_salaries_history ORDER BY fy, stage

questions.question: And total expenses?
questions.sql: SELECT fy, stage, total FROM total_expenses_history ORDER BY fy, stage

questions.question: How many special education paraprofessionals were budgeted, by school and year?
questions.sql: SELECT fy, stage, ps, es, ms, hs, total FROM sped_para_history ORDER BY fy, stage
questions.note: This is the line the 12.8% escalator rests on, and it is dollars, not people.

questions.question: And special education teachers?
questions.sql: SELECT fy, stage, ps, es, ms, hs, total FROM sped_teacher_history ORDER BY fy, stage

questions.question: What has out-of-district tuition done, year by year?
questions.sql: SELECT fy, stage, private, collaborative, total FROM ood_tuition_history ORDER BY fy, stage

questions.question: How many children were placed outside the district, and where?
questions.sql: SELECT fy, as_of, total, collaborative, day, residential FROM placement_counts ORDER BY fy
questions.note: A count of children placed. It says nothing about which fund paid or what a placement cost, so it does not settle the money.

questions.question: Do the placement counts tie to their own parts, and to the prior year?
questions.sql: SELECT fy, parts_tie, chain_agrees, report_says_prior_year FROM placement_counts ORDER BY fy

questions.question: What has special education transportation cost, by year?
questions.sql: SELECT fy, stage, system, total FROM sped_transport_history ORDER BY fy, stage

questions.question: Does each year of the placement series agree with what the next report says of it?
questions.sql: SELECT fy, total, report_says_prior_year, chain_agrees FROM placement_counts ORDER BY fy
questions.note: Two checks travel with this series: the parts sum to the total, and each year states the previous year's figure. `n/a` is the first year, which has nothing before it.

questions.question: What did each department spend against its budget, in the latest period held?
questions.sql: SELECT a.dept, a.name, l.fy, l.period, ROUND(l.revised) AS revised, ROUND(l.expended) AS expended, ROUND(l.available) AS available FROM ledger_snapshot l JOIN account a USING (account_id) WHERE a.level='department' ORDER BY l.fy DESC, l.period DESC, l.revised DESC LIMIT 20

questions.question: Which departments are spending faster than the year is elapsing?
questions.sql: SELECT dept, name, fy, period, ROUND(year_elapsed,2) AS year_elapsed, ROUND(spent_share,2) AS spent_share, ROUND(pace_gap,2) AS pace_gap FROM v_burn WHERE pace_gap IS NOT NULL ORDER BY pace_gap DESC LIMIT 20

questions.question: What funds does the town keep, and what restricts them?
questions.sql: SELECT kind, COUNT(*) AS funds FROM fund GROUP BY kind ORDER BY funds DESC

questions.question: What moved through the special revenue funds in each year?
questions.sql: SELECT fund, fy, period, ROUND(opening_balance) AS opening, ROUND(revenue) AS revenue, ROUND(expenditure) AS spent, ROUND(closing_balance) AS closing FROM fund_activity ORDER BY fy DESC, revenue DESC LIMIT 20

questions.question: How many accounts are there at each level of the chart?
questions.sql: SELECT level, account_type, COUNT(*) AS accounts FROM account GROUP BY level, account_type ORDER BY accounts DESC

questions.question: Which grants did the district receive, and who owns them?
questions.sql: SELECT fy, kind, name, ROUND(amount) AS amount, owner FROM grant_award ORDER BY fy DESC, amount DESC LIMIT 20

questions.question: What does the ledger hold for each fiscal year and period?
questions.sql: SELECT fy, period, COUNT(*) AS rows, COUNT(DISTINCT account_id) AS accounts FROM ledger_snapshot GROUP BY fy, period ORDER BY fy, period
questions.note: Period 13 is the year-end close, after purchase orders are cleared. Period 12 is not the end of the year.

questions.question: Which function codes can be compared between the budget and the ledger?
questions.sql: SELECT function_code, fy, period, ROUND(ledger_revised) AS revised, ROUND(ledger_expended) AS expended, budget_lines FROM v_function_budget_vs_ledger ORDER BY ledger_revised DESC LIMIT 20
questions.note: This is the level at which the two systems join. Below it they do not: the town shortens account names to ten characters.

questions.question: How much did each function group budget and spend across all years?
questions.sql: SELECT function_group, years, ROUND(budgeted) AS budgeted, ROUND(spent) AS spent, ROUND(net) AS net, worst_year FROM variance_by_group ORDER BY ABS(net) DESC LIMIT 20

questions.question: What went through fund 1301, and when?
questions.sql: SELECT fy, period, eff_date, src_meaning, COUNT(*) AS entries FROM fund_1301_cash_journal GROUP BY fy, period, eff_date, src_meaning ORDER BY fy DESC, eff_date DESC LIMIT 20

questions.question: How many people of each kind did the town print on a roster, by year?
questions.sql: SELECT fy, role_category, COUNT(*) AS people FROM v_staff_roster WHERE role_category <> 'unknown' GROUP BY fy, role_category ORDER BY fy, people DESC
questions.note: A count of names the town printed. It carries no FTE and no funding source, so it is not a staffing level.

questions.question: How many paraprofessionals, by school and year?
questions.sql: SELECT fy, school, COUNT(*) AS paras FROM v_staff_roster WHERE role_category='paraprofessional' GROUP BY fy, school ORDER BY fy, paras DESC

questions.question: How many paraprofessionals were tied to a named grade?
questions.sql: SELECT fy, role_grade, COUNT(*) AS paras FROM v_staff_roster WHERE role_category='paraprofessional' AND role_grade <> '' GROUP BY fy, role_grade ORDER BY fy, role_grade

questions.question: What did the town print as the title for a paraprofessional, year by year?
questions.sql: SELECT fy, role_raw, COUNT(*) AS rows FROM v_staff_roster WHERE role_category='paraprofessional' AND role_raw <> '' GROUP BY fy, role_raw ORDER BY fy, rows DESC
questions.note: Tutor, Aide, Tutors/Aides, Paraprofessional, Para, (para), Sped Para. Five names for one job across fifteen years, which is why `role_category` exists.

questions.question: Which roster titles could not be classified at all?
questions.sql: SELECT role_raw, grade_or_dept, rows FROM role_classification WHERE role_category='unknown' ORDER BY rows DESC LIMIT 20
questions.note: Left `unknown` rather than guessed. 8% of rows.

questions.question: Which rule decided each classification, and how much rests on the weakest ones?
questions.sql: SELECT classified_by, role_category, SUM(rows) AS rows FROM role_classification GROUP BY classified_by, role_category ORDER BY rows DESC
questions.note: A rule beginning `heading-` read the section heading rather than a printed title, which is weaker evidence.

questions.question: How many names appear on each school roster in each year?
questions.sql: SELECT fy, school, position, count FROM staff_roster_counts ORDER BY fy DESC, count DESC LIMIT 20

questions.question: How many teachers were printed against a specific grade?
questions.sql: SELECT fy, role_grade, COUNT(*) AS teachers FROM v_staff_roster WHERE role_category='teacher' AND role_grade <> '' GROUP BY fy, role_grade ORDER BY fy DESC, role_grade

questions.question: Which schools have roster entries, and for which years?
questions.sql: SELECT school, COUNT(DISTINCT fy) AS years, MIN(fy) AS first, MAX(fy) AS last, COUNT(*) AS rows FROM staff_roster_entries GROUP BY school ORDER BY rows DESC

questions.question: How many counselors, nurses, psychologists and social workers, by year?
questions.sql: SELECT fy, role_category, COUNT(*) AS people FROM v_staff_roster WHERE role_category IN ('counselor','nurse','psychologist','social_worker','speech_therapist') GROUP BY fy, role_category ORDER BY fy, role_category

questions.question: What did each sport cost, and how many played?
questions.sql: SELECT fy, season, level, sport, metric, value FROM athletics_by_sport WHERE is_numeric='1' ORDER BY fy DESC, value DESC LIMIT 20

questions.question: Do the per-sport figures add up to the totals the district printed?
questions.sql: SELECT season, scope, metric, fy, printed, summed_from_rows, difference, ties FROM athletics_by_sport_reconciliation ORDER BY ABS(CAST(difference AS REAL)) DESC LIMIT 20

questions.question: What has athletics cost and raised, year by year?
questions.sql: SELECT fy, side, item, amount, basis FROM athletics_history ORDER BY fy DESC, side

questions.question: What has the athletic fee been, by year and tier?
questions.sql: SELECT fy, school_year, level, item, amount, unit, verified FROM athletic_fee_schedule ORDER BY fy DESC, level

questions.question: Which rates does this project know about, and which does it use?
questions.sql: SELECT fy, category, item, value, value_type, set_on FROM rate_register ORDER BY fy DESC, category LIMIT 20
questions.note: It deliberately includes rates the model does NOT use, and the ones that cannot be stated at all.

questions.question: Which rates were set by a document we hold, and which were not?
questions.sql: SELECT category, COUNT(*) AS rates, SUM(CASE WHEN source_file <> '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS with_a_document FROM rate_register GROUP BY category ORDER BY rates DESC

questions.question: What appropriations did each annual report print, and are the rows checked?
questions.sql: SELECT edition, status, COUNT(*) AS rows FROM report_appropriations GROUP BY edition, status ORDER BY edition, rows DESC
questions.note: ALWAYS split on `status`. `checked`, `check failed` and `no check` are three different claims and nothing may be aggregated across them.

questions.question: What did the town pay in gross wages, and to how many people?
questions.sql: SELECT edition, status, COUNT(*) AS rows FROM report_gross_wages GROUP BY edition, status ORDER BY edition

questions.question: What debt has the town carried?
questions.sql: SELECT edition, COUNT(*) AS rows, SUM(CASE WHEN status='checked' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS checked FROM report_debt GROUP BY edition ORDER BY edition

questions.question: What capital projects did the reports list?
questions.sql: SELECT edition, label, status FROM report_capital_projects WHERE label <> '' ORDER BY edition DESC LIMIT 20

questions.question: What is in the trust funds?
questions.sql: SELECT edition, COUNT(*) AS rows FROM report_trust_funds GROUP BY edition ORDER BY edition

questions.question: What did the town value its property at?
questions.sql: SELECT edition, label, status FROM report_valuation WHERE label <> '' ORDER BY edition DESC LIMIT 20

questions.question: What enrollment and MCAS results were printed?
questions.sql: SELECT edition, COUNT(*) AS rows FROM report_enrollment_mcas GROUP BY edition ORDER BY edition

questions.question: What did the town assess for Monty Tech?
questions.sql: SELECT edition, label, status FROM report_monty_tech WHERE label <> '' ORDER BY edition DESC LIMIT 20

questions.question: How many births, deaths and marriages were recorded?
questions.sql: SELECT edition, label, status FROM report_vital_records WHERE label <> '' ORDER BY edition DESC LIMIT 20

questions.question: Who held town office, and when?
questions.sql: SELECT edition, label FROM report_officials WHERE label <> '' ORDER BY edition DESC LIMIT 20

questions.question: What did each department report doing?
questions.sql: SELECT edition, COUNT(*) AS rows FROM report_dept_activity GROUP BY edition ORDER BY edition

questions.question: What receipts did the town record, and from what source?
questions.sql: SELECT fy, source, amount, status FROM annual_report_receipts ORDER BY fy DESC, CAST(amount AS REAL) DESC LIMIT 20

questions.question: What tables does each annual report contain?
questions.sql: SELECT fy, [table], pages, figure_rows, checkable FROM annual_report_contents ORDER BY fy DESC, figure_rows DESC LIMIT 20

questions.question: Which tables in the reports were read, and which are still uncaptured?
questions.sql: SELECT dataset, COUNT(*) AS editions, SUM(CASE WHEN extractable='yes' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS extractable FROM extraction_plan GROUP BY dataset ORDER BY editions DESC LIMIT 20

questions.question: What did the survey find on each page of each report?
questions.sql: SELECT fy, mode, COUNT(*) AS pages, SUM(money) AS money_tokens FROM annual_report_survey GROUP BY fy, mode ORDER BY fy, pages DESC

questions.question: What is catalogued in each report, by printed heading?
questions.sql: SELECT fy, printed_heading, pages, grain FROM annual_report_catalogue WHERE printed_heading <> '' ORDER BY fy DESC LIMIT 20

questions.question: Where did the extraction find something it could not reconcile?
questions.sql: SELECT fy, edition, [table], kind, detail FROM report_anomalies ORDER BY fy DESC LIMIT 20
questions.note: An anomaly is a finding about our reading of the page as much as about the page.

questions.question: Which special revenue funds appear in the reports, and in which years?
questions.sql: SELECT fy, [group], COUNT(*) AS rows FROM special_revenue_funds GROUP BY fy, [group] ORDER BY fy DESC, rows DESC LIMIT 20

questions.theme: Revenue, tax base and free cash
questions.question: What free cash has each town certified, and from what?
questions.sql: SELECT town, year, line, amount, role FROM free_cash_proof ORDER BY year DESC, town LIMIT 20
questions.note: Absolute dollars with no denominator, so they do not compare between towns of different size. The composition does compare, because a share has no size.

questions.theme: Revenue, tax base and free cash
questions.question: How does Lunenburg free cash compare with its neighbours, by composition?
questions.sql: SELECT town, year, line, amount FROM free_cash_proof WHERE role='component' ORDER BY year DESC, town LIMIT 20

questions.theme: Revenue, tax base and free cash
questions.question: What has the town spent on capital, and where did the money come from?
questions.sql: SELECT fy, total, free_cash, taxation, unexpended_prior_year_capital, other FROM capital_funding_history ORDER BY fy

questions.theme: Revenue, tax base and free cash
questions.question: What is in the FY27 capital plan, and what is funded?
questions.sql: SELECT rank, dept, project, cost, funded, funding FROM capital_plan_fy27 ORDER BY rank

questions.theme: Revenue, tax base and free cash
questions.question: How do state measures compare Lunenburg with other districts?
questions.sql: SELECT district, fy, measure, value FROM dese_measure WHERE district <> '' ORDER BY fy DESC LIMIT 20

questions.theme: Revenue, tax base and free cash
questions.question: Which DESE measures reconcile against the printed totals, and which do not?
questions.sql: SELECT measure, COUNT(*) AS rows, SUM(CASE WHEN reconciles='1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS reconciling FROM dese_measure GROUP BY measure ORDER BY rows DESC LIMIT 15

questions.question: What has the town been asked to fund, and did it agree?
questions.sql: SELECT date, election, question, type, amount, yes, no, total FROM ballot_questions ORDER BY date DESC

questions.question: What turnout did each ballot question draw?
questions.sql: SELECT date, question, total, registered, ROUND(100.0*total/registered,1) AS turnout_pct FROM ballot_questions WHERE registered > 0 ORDER BY date DESC

questions.question: What election results did the annual reports print?
questions.sql: SELECT edition, COUNT(*) AS rows FROM report_elections GROUP BY edition ORDER BY edition

questions.theme: Provenance, and what is not established
questions.question: Where did a figure in this dataset come from?
questions.sql: SELECT dataset, edition, document, publisher_label, sha256 FROM dataset_document ORDER BY dataset, edition LIMIT 20
questions.note: This is the join that gives an annual-report row an address. Use it in any query whose answer somebody might want to check.

questions.theme: Provenance, and what is not established
questions.question: Which documents does the archive hold, and how were they obtained?
questions.sql: SELECT source_type, basis, COUNT(*) AS documents FROM document GROUP BY source_type, basis ORDER BY documents DESC

questions.theme: Provenance, and what is not established
questions.question: Which documents no longer open at the publisher, or no longer match our copy?
questions.sql: SELECT doc_id, link_state, copy_state, url FROM document WHERE copy_state NOT IN ('identical','') OR link_state NOT IN ('200','') LIMIT 20

questions.theme: Provenance, and what is not established
questions.question: Which documents have no upstream address at all?
questions.sql: SELECT doc_id, source_type FROM document WHERE url IS NULL OR url='' LIMIT 20
questions.note: A gap on our side, not the town's: they were gathered before the mirror existed and nobody wrote down where they came from.

questions.theme: Provenance, and what is not established
questions.question: Where do two sources state the same budget line differently?
questions.sql: SELECT label, fy, stage, source, value, is_kept FROM line_history_disagreements ORDER BY fy DESC, label LIMIT 20

questions.theme: Provenance, and what is not established
questions.question: How much of each dataset has been checked against the page it came from?
questions.sql: SELECT dataset, reconciled, partial, SUM(CAST(rows AS INTEGER)) AS rows FROM dataset_document GROUP BY dataset, reconciled, partial ORDER BY rows DESC LIMIT 20

questions.theme: Provenance, and what is not established
questions.question: Which figures has somebody stated publicly, and on what basis?
questions.sql: SELECT fy, metric, amount, stated_by, stated_on, basis FROM stated_figure ORDER BY fy DESC

questions.theme: Provenance, and what is not established
questions.question: Which budget lines have no ledger account mapped to them?
questions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS budget_lines, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM crosswalk) AS mapped FROM budget_line
questions.note: The crosswalk is empty ON PURPOSE. District lines are named, MUNIS rows are coded, and no published document maps one to the other. Budget-to-actual at line level cannot be answered from this data.

questions.theme: Provenance, and what is not established
questions.question: Which pages of the annual reports have columns we could not establish?
questions.sql: SELECT edition, COUNT(*) AS rows FROM report_appropriations WHERE column_meaning LIKE 'not established%' GROUP BY edition ORDER BY rows DESC
questions.note: `v1` is an ordinal -- the first column of THIS page that held figures -- not a column name. Read `column_meaning` before summing anything.

questions.theme: Provenance, and what is not established
questions.question: How many rows of each report table failed their own check?
questions.sql: SELECT 'appropriations' AS t, status, COUNT(*) AS rows FROM report_appropriations GROUP BY status UNION ALL SELECT 'gross_wages', status, COUNT(*) FROM report_gross_wages GROUP BY status ORDER BY t, rows DESC

questions.question: What tables are there, and how big are they?
questions.sql: SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type IN ('table','view') ORDER BY type, name

questions.question: What fiscal years does the archive cover, per dataset?
questions.sql: SELECT dataset, MIN(edition) AS first, MAX(edition) AS last, COUNT(*) AS editions FROM dataset_document GROUP BY dataset ORDER BY dataset

questions.question: What does one fiscal period mean?
questions.sql: SELECT period, label, months_elapsed, is_final FROM fiscal_period ORDER BY period

questions.question: What is the biggest single line in the budget, in each year?
questions.sql: SELECT f.fy, b.label, ROUND(MAX(f.value)) AS value FROM budget_figure f JOIN budget_line b USING (line_key) WHERE f.stage='settled' GROUP BY f.fy ORDER BY f.fy DESC

questions.question: How many lines does each budget document state?
questions.sql: SELECT doc_id, COUNT(*) AS figures, COUNT(DISTINCT fy) AS years FROM budget_figure GROUP BY doc_id ORDER BY figures DESC LIMIT 15

questions.question: Which lines exist in one scenario but not another?
questions.sql: SELECT line_key, COUNT(DISTINCT variant) AS variants FROM budget_figure WHERE fy=2027 AND variant IS NOT NULL GROUP BY line_key ORDER BY variants LIMIT 15

questions.question: What does the FY27 workbook say each line was in FY25?
questions.sql: SELECT line_key, column_kind, ROUND(value) AS value FROM workbook_figure WHERE fy=2025 AND row_kind='line' ORDER BY value DESC LIMIT 20

questions.question: Which accounts had the largest unspent balance at the latest period?
questions.sql: SELECT a.name, a.fund_name, l.fy, l.period, ROUND(l.available) AS available FROM ledger_snapshot l JOIN account a USING (account_id) ORDER BY l.fy DESC, l.period DESC, l.available DESC LIMIT 20

questions.question: How much was transferred into or out of each account?
questions.sql: SELECT a.name, l.fy, l.period, ROUND(l.transfers) AS transfers FROM ledger_snapshot l JOIN account a USING (account_id) WHERE l.transfers <> 0 ORDER BY ABS(l.transfers) DESC LIMIT 20
questions.note: `transfers` is CUMULATIVE. Movement between two periods is the difference of the column, never the later value.

questions.question: Which accounts are revenue rather than expenditure?
questions.sql: SELECT account_type, level, COUNT(*) AS accounts FROM account GROUP BY account_type, level ORDER BY accounts DESC
questions.note: Revenue rows are stored NEGATIVE, exactly as MUNIS prints them. Check `account_type` before doing arithmetic across types.

questions.question: What share of its budget had each department used?
questions.sql: SELECT a.dept, a.name, l.fy, l.period, ROUND(l.pct_used,1) AS pct_used FROM ledger_snapshot l JOIN account a USING (account_id) WHERE l.pct_used IS NOT NULL ORDER BY l.pct_used DESC LIMIT 20

questions.question: How many people did the town print on a roster in total, by year?
questions.sql: SELECT fy, COUNT(*) AS names, COUNT(DISTINCT school) AS schools FROM v_staff_roster GROUP BY fy ORDER BY fy

questions.question: Which names appear across the most years?
questions.sql: SELECT name, COUNT(DISTINCT fy) AS years, MIN(fy) AS first, MAX(fy) AS last FROM staff_roster_entries WHERE name <> '' GROUP BY name ORDER BY years DESC, name LIMIT 20
questions.note: A name printed in a public annual report. It is not a claim about employment, and a roster gives no FTE.

questions.question: How many administrators did each school print?
questions.sql: SELECT fy, school, COUNT(*) AS admins FROM v_staff_roster WHERE role_category='administrator' GROUP BY fy, school ORDER BY fy DESC, admins DESC LIMIT 20

questions.question: Which grades appear anywhere on the rosters?
questions.sql: SELECT role_grade, COUNT(*) AS rows FROM v_staff_roster WHERE role_grade <> '' GROUP BY role_grade ORDER BY rows DESC

questions.question: How many figures did each annual report yield, and how many were checked?
questions.sql: SELECT edition, COUNT(*) AS rows, SUM(CASE WHEN status='checked' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS checked FROM report_appropriations GROUP BY edition ORDER BY edition

questions.question: Which report tables print a total we can reconcile to?
questions.sql: SELECT fy, [table], printed_total, checkable FROM annual_report_contents WHERE printed_total <> '' ORDER BY fy DESC LIMIT 20

questions.question: How many pages of each report carried figures at all?
questions.sql: SELECT fy, COUNT(*) AS pages, SUM(CASE WHEN money > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS with_money FROM annual_report_survey GROUP BY fy ORDER BY fy

questions.question: What kinds of anomaly did the extraction find, and how often?
questions.sql: SELECT kind, COUNT(*) AS occurrences FROM report_anomalies GROUP BY kind ORDER BY occurrences DESC

questions.theme: Revenue, tax base and free cash
questions.question: How has free cash moved for Lunenburg specifically?
questions.sql: SELECT year, line, amount, role FROM free_cash_proof WHERE town='Lunenburg' ORDER BY year DESC, line

questions.theme: Revenue, tax base and free cash
questions.question: Which towns does the free cash comparison cover?
questions.sql: SELECT town, COUNT(DISTINCT year) AS years, MIN(year) AS first, MAX(year) AS last FROM free_cash_proof GROUP BY town ORDER BY town

questions.theme: Revenue, tax base and free cash
questions.question: What measures does the state publish about this district?
questions.sql: SELECT measure, COUNT(*) AS rows, MIN(fy) AS first, MAX(fy) AS last FROM dese_measure GROUP BY measure ORDER BY rows DESC LIMIT 15

questions.theme: Provenance, and what is not established
questions.question: Which documents were obtained by records request rather than published?
questions.sql: SELECT source_type, COUNT(*) AS documents FROM document GROUP BY source_type ORDER BY documents DESC

questions.theme: Provenance, and what is not established
questions.question: What basis does each document have for the figures it prints?
questions.sql: SELECT basis, COUNT(*) AS documents FROM document WHERE basis IS NOT NULL GROUP BY basis ORDER BY documents DESC
questions.note: `ledger` means a figure exists because a transaction did. `restatement` means a prior year re-presented by the party that spent it. They are not interchangeable.

questions.theme: Provenance, and what is not established
questions.question: Which datasets have a document for every edition, and which do not?
questions.sql: SELECT dataset, COUNT(*) AS editions, SUM(CASE WHEN document <> '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS with_a_document FROM dataset_document GROUP BY dataset ORDER BY editions DESC

questions.theme: Provenance, and what is not established
questions.question: How many rows of each dataset came off each page?
questions.sql: SELECT dataset, edition, pages, rows FROM dataset_document ORDER BY CAST(rows AS INTEGER) DESC LIMIT 20
